title: Fast-growing Hawk Fire explodes to 10,000 acres, spurs evacuations outside Reno
description: About 1,000 homes were threatened, authorities said.

title: ‘It’s Been Terrible’: Thousands in Indiana Remain Without Power
description: Gov. Mike Braun called on the local utility to “match the urgency” of Gary area residents who have had to endure an outage approaching its second week.

title: Liberty’s Leonie Fiebich has big night, shows rare on-court emotion in return from lengthy injury
description: Leonie Fiebich is usually stoic on the court for the Liberty. But playing her first game in seven weeks Saturday, she let the emotion pour out.

title: Judge denies Karmelo Anthony's appeal for a new trial in killing of Austin Metcalf
description: The decision comes after both prosecutors and Anthony's new defense team revealed more details in a tense two-day hearing.

title: Maniac fires wildly on Brooklyn Street, shooting dog that miraculously survived
description: Police are hunting for a ruthless gunman who opened fire on a Brooklyn street Wednesday afternoon, nearly killing a developmentally delayed woman and leaving her family's beloved dog bleeding from a bullet wound.
